verdict.rationale: Codegen is a cloud coding-agent platform, so bring-your-own-model or API-key support is a fair axis. Nothing in the pack documents model selection, BYO LLM providers, or supplying your own API key. The CLI's wrapping of local Claude Code is telemetry and integration plumbing, not model choice for Codegen's agents. The SDK token shown is a Codegen auth token, not an LLM key.
